europe_now.title: EU transfers €1.4bn from frozen Russian assets to Ukraine
europe_now.summary: The European Union has transferred €1.4 billion in interest from frozen Russian assets to Ukraine following a deadly attack on Kyiv. This financial support is part of the EU’s response to the conflict.

europe_now.title: Explosive drone found at German airport
europe_now.summary: German anti‑terror police are investigating an explosive drone discovered at Leipzig airport. The incident raises security concerns amid heightened vigilance in Europe.
